recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-29408 unless a future work-group decision changes the contained-resource container-reference rule.
issue_request: FHIR-29408 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core DomainResource after being raised against R4. It reported that dom-3 did not handle a contained resource pointing back to its containing resource and proposed allowing the contained-container case with the local-reference expression branch reference='#' and %rootResource!=%resource.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-29408 was found. The Jira comment says the issue was dealt with in a previous technical correction; the surrounding history shows FHIR-13187 established the DomainResource dom-3 allowance and FHIR-31732 later applied the exact ref-1 expression branch now present in Reference.
additional_context: DomainResource is active in source/fhir.ini and Reference is an active datatype. Current source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml has dom-3 human text and an expression that allow a contained resource to refer to its container, current source/datatypes/reference.xml has the requested reference='#' and %rootResource!=%resource branch, FHIR-43690 later optimized dom-3 without changing that behavior, and FHIR-41692 was retracted after recognizing '#' as the correct container reference. Bounded community searches found supporting discussion and FHIR-I minutes for the related correction but no conflicting later final decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source file was edited because the current authoritative source already satisfies the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: Established the dom-3 rule that a contained resource may satisfy the invariant by referring to the containing resource.
Applied the ref-1 local-reference branch for reference='#' and %rootResource!=%resource, matching the expression requested in FHIR-29408.
Optimized dom-3 in R6 while preserving the branch that detects a contained resource referencing its container.
Retracted later concern about dom-3 after recognizing that the correct container reference is '#'.
